entities.name: Lower bound timer value
entities.description: An information element that provides a minimum time value for an entry added to the list of PLMNs not allowed to operate at the present UE location.

entities.name: 5GMM cause #78 PLMN not allowed to operate at the present UE location
entities.description: Condition where the 5GMM cause is set to #78 indicating PLMN not allowed to operate at the present UE location.

entities.name: Minimum time value for PLMN list entry
entities.description: Property specifying the minimum time value for an entry added to the list of PLMNs not allowed to operate at the present UE location.

relations.description: The AMF may include the Lower bound timer value IE when the 5GMM cause is set to #78.
The Lower bound timer value IE provides the minimum time value for an entry added to the list of PLMNs not allowed to operate at the present UE location.
